subject: GDPR: DPA pathing, SCC options & questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@fintechsolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + immediate asks: DPA, SCC direction & questionnaire kickoff

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

1) Roles: you indicated FinTech Solutions will be the data controller for customer data in this flow; Redwood would act as the processor. Please confirm if that remains accurate after you review with your privacy team.

2) DPA: Attached is a first-pass Redwood DPA (redwood_dpa_draft_v1.docx). If you could have legal highlight any must-have edits, we’ll prioritize those.

3) SCCs: For now we’re preparing the SCC module set that maps to controller -> processor. We can switch to an alternative module if your legal team prefers; flagging now so we don’t pick the wrong clause set.

4) Security questionnaire: I’m attaching our vendor questionnaire (redwood_security_questionnaire.pdf). If your security team wants to kick off the questionnaire, we can accept the completed PDF or you can send an initial export into the shared Drive link below.

5) SOC 2 / Certifications: Quick note from my side — Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II in production (report available under NDA). I’ll have Neha share the onboarding checklist and the SOC 2 summary doc once you confirm NDA routing.

Proposed immediate next actions:
- Elena / Security: confirm controller/processor role in writing (reply to this thread) — due 2026-06-24
- FinTech legal: review the attached DPA and flag material redlines — due 2026-06-26
- Security: start questionnaire or tell me preferred intake method; I’ll send the Drive link and a HubSpot task — due 2026-06-26
- Schedule 30-min legal+security sync: I propose Tue 2026-06-29 14:00 PT — Google Meet link here: https://redwood.app/sg/meeting/2026-06-29-14

Thanks — I’ll follow up on the HubSpot side as well.

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
+1 415 555 0123

Attachments: redwood_dpa_draft_v1.docx (DPA draft), redwood_security_questionnaire.pdf (vendor questionnaire)
From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@fintechsolutions.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinTech Solutions Security <security@fintechsolutions.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + immediate asks: DPA, SCC direction & questionnaire kickoff

Hi Vivek — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Role: confirmed — FinTech Solutions is the controller for customer transaction data; Redwood would be processor for tokenized datasets used by our analytics pipelines. I’ll loop in our privacy counsel but this is a firm expectation from product and legal.

- SCC modules: we prefer the controller->processor module too (that aligns with our internal precedent).

- SOC 2: we require either a SOC 2 Type II report or current annual Attestation. Can you confirm whether Redwood’s report covers hosting/infrastructure components you’ll be using? If not, we’ll need a short gap analysis.

- Questionnaire intake: security@fintechsolutions.com prefers the Drive intake link (shared folder). Please drop a writable copy there and I’ll have them start the questionnaire.

I’ll confirm timing for the legal review of the DPA by Friday (26th).

Regards,
Elena
Head of Privacy & Compliance
FinTech Solutions

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Recap + immediate asks: DPA, SCC direction & questionnaire kickoff

Vivek / Neha — internal notes after Elena’s confirmation: 

- Controller/processor alignment: they’ve confirmed controller -> processor. Proceed with SCC set for controller->processor (module 2 equivalent). I’ll prepare a short cover memo we can attach to the DPA to speed their counsel’s review.

- DPA redlines: we should proactively: add clearer subprocessors list & SLAs for deletion, include a 30-day security incident notice clause, and make the authorized subprocessor onboarding process explicit. I’ll draft those bullets and send a mark-up by EOD Thu (2026-06-25).

- SOC 2 scope: Neha — can you check which infra components are in scope for our most recent Type II? If hosting (cloud region) isn’t covered, prepare a 1-page gap note for Elena.

- Questionnaire: I suggest we pre-fill parts of the questionnaire (company details, contact points, standard policies) to cut their work. I’ll coordinate with Trust & Safety to produce the pre-fill package.

- Meeting: Tue 06/29 14:00 PT works for me. I’ll be on the call to run through DPA items with their legal.

Thanks — this is a standard flow. Keep the HubSpot deal updated (assign tasks for legal/security) and push the NDA if they want the SOC 2 attached.

Marissa
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@fintechsolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + immediate asks: DPA, SCC direction & questionnaire kickoff

Elena — thanks for confirming. Actions we’ve taken on our side: 

- Uploaded a writable copy of the questionnaire to your requested Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/questionnaires/fintech-solutions-v1 (you should have edit access).
- Attached the DPA draft with a short cover note from Marissa (see attachments).
- Neha is pulling SOC 2 scoping info now; I’ll post the 1-page summary to this thread by tomorrow.
- HubSpot: created a task for your legal review (RDW-2026-FTS-0098).

Proposed meeting: Tue, Jun 29 14:00 PT — holding the slot and sending calendar invite now. If you prefer an earlier sync, happy to move.

Link to questionnaire (Drive): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/questionnaires/fintech-solutions-v1
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3421/RDW-2026-FTS-0098

Look forward to next steps.

Best,
Vivek
From: FinTech Solutions Security <security@fintechsolutions.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Elena Rodriguez <elena@fintechsolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Completed: initial questionnaire answers (partial)

Hi team — we’ve started the intake and attached a partial answers export (fts_initial_answers_20260626.pdf). Highlights:
- Confirmed controller role for customer data.
- SOC 2: requesting Type II report; will require NDA before we accept full report.
- Questions about subprocessors: please provide current list or point us to the live subprocessor registry.

Next steps from our side: we’ll hand the redlines for the DPA to legal by Monday 2026-06-29 after internal review. We’ll also join the Tue 06/29 14:00 PT sync — calendar invite accepted.

Thanks,
FinTech Solutions Security
security@fintechsolutions.com

Attachments: fts_initial_answers_20260626.pdf (partial questionnaire answers)
